storageReplay.sqlite: real file-backed SQLite from the current local-first baseline with injected transaction faults
storageReplay.prose: real Yjs snapshots/updates committed through the prose coordinator
storageReplay.localProjection: Zustand/localStorage state deliberately cleared and rebuilt

transientTurnCommitRetry.requiredName: retries an idempotent durable commit before publishing the completed terminal

permanentTurnCommitFailClosed.requiredName: fails the live canonical terminal closed when the completed turn cannot commit

lostSqliteCommitAcknowledgement.requiredName: adopts one exact history when SQLite committed but the first commit acknowledgement was lost

orderedBlockLedger.requiredName: persists ordered settlement blocks and settles the receipt atomically with the last one

projectReceiptRecovery.requiredName: settles a pending block receipt during project hydration

sessionReceiptRecovery.requiredName: settles a pending block receipt during session hydration

missingReceiptRecovery.requiredName: recovers and settles a missing settlement receipt without replaying editor UI

postCommitSettlementFault.requiredName: settles a prose receipt whose acknowledgement failed after Yjs committed during project hydration

migrationKeepsReceipts.requiredName: drops the reject/revert columns and keeps every settlement receipt and block

migrationRefusesReviewDecision.requiredName: refuses a database holding a review reject decision and leaves it unchanged

migrationRefusesBlockDecision.requiredName: refuses a database holding a block reject decision and leaves it unchanged

receiptBatchIdempotence.requiredName: records a receipt batch once and clears it only when settlement resolves it

retiredCacheMigration.requiredName: reads a v1 cache without its retired reject queue and drops a v0 cache

nativeScrollRevealCoordinates.requiredName: keeps reveal coordinates stable inside the native scrolling content tree

sqliteProjectionWins.requiredName: keeps a canonical pending receipt and removes it after settlement

boundaries.nativeAnimationAppearance: direction and selection are deterministic; visual smoothness remains user/native acceptance
boundaries.deviceRestart: file/process restart is headless; platform lifecycle acceptance remains milestone J
boundaries.providerNetwork: not required for storage semantics; multi-provider conformance remains milestone I
